name: agentic-s2p-platform
description: Enterprise Agentic S2P Platform: Separate Buyer Portal and Smart Supplier Collaboration Portal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,BUYER,SUPPLIER" -c "blue,cyan,green" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:buyer" "npm run dev:supplier"
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../buyer-portal && npm run build && cd ../supplier-portal && npm run build
